tagline.en: X Square Robot's Wall-OSS — an open vision-language-action policy built on the Wall-X family, offered in flow and fast variants.
tagline.zh: X Square Robot 的 Wall-OSS——基于 Wall-X 家族的开放视觉-语言-动作策略,提供 flow 与 fast 两个版本。

en: Wall-OSS is an open vision-language-action model from X Square Robot, built on the Wall-X policy line. It maps visual observations and language instructions to robot actions, aimed at general-purpose embodied control.
Two checkpoints are published: a flow variant and a fast variant, so you can trade off between generation style and speed. The weights are available openly on Hugging Face.

In WorldFoundry, Wall-OSS runs through an in-tree action runtime adapter against the concrete Wall-X policy. You stage the checkpoint you want; the runtime reports if it is missing so you can add it before running.
zh: Wall-OSS 是 X Square Robot 推出的开放视觉-语言-动作模型,基于 Wall-X 策略系列。它把视觉观测与语言指令映射为机器人动作,面向通用具身控制。
已发布两个 checkpoint:flow 版本与 fast 版本,方便你在生成方式与速度之间权衡。权重在 Hugging Face 上开放提供。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Wall-OSS 通过内置动作运行时适配器,对接具体的 Wall-X 策略运行。你准备好想用的 checkpoint 即可;若缺失,运行时会提示,便于你在运行前补齐。

whenToUse.en: Use Wall-OSS when you want an openly available VLA policy for robot control and need to choose between a flow variant and a faster variant for your latency budget.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放可得的 VLA 策略做机器人控制,并需要在 flow 版本与更快的版本之间按延迟预算选择时,适合使用 Wall-OSS。

notFor.en: As a policy it needs the matching checkpoint staged and a compatible robot/task setup; it is not a text-to-video or scene-generation model.
notFor.zh: 作为策略,它需要准备好对应的 checkpoint 以及兼容的机器人/任务设置;它不是文生视频或场景生成模型。
